caption: The drawing depicts a decorative, scallop-edged, black plaque or tray seen against a plain, light-colored background. Inside the black tray, there is a stylized image of a steam locomotive pulling a wagon. The locomotive is colored in yellowish-gold with red and white details, including a smokestack emitting striped smoke and a small red flag on top. The attached wagon is filled with a crisscross pattern of goods or crates, highlighted with touches of red and yellow. Both the locomotive and wagon have visible wheels and sit on a linear base. Below the train, within the tray, are painted leafy green and yellow plants with clusters of red berries. The tray’s wide rim is decorated with a repeating pattern of gold and yellow circular and heart-shaped motifs. The artist’s signature and the date "36" appear in green at the bottom right section of the tray, with another set of blue numbers in the lower right margin of the image.
title: Toleware Tin Tray
